title: Personal Training Packages: multi-package, corporate wellness, and seasonal promotional discount rates by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, the discount rate applied to a second concurrent package, the discount rate available when the purchase is bundled with an active corporate wellness enrollment, and the discount rate applied during promotional periods. How the multi-package and corporate wellness discounts interact at purchase (whichever single discount is higher rather than the two stacking) is stated in the package purchase pricing basis document, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Multi-package discount (percent) | Corporate wellness discount (percent) | Seasonal promotional discount (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | 10 | 8 | 5 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | 10 | 5 | 0 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | 10 | 10 | 0 |

## Points of reference
Every tier of Personal Training Packages lists the same 10 percent multi-package discount rate. The corporate wellness discount rate is 5 percent on four of the six tiers, rising to 8 percent on 20-Session Performance Pack and to 10 percent on Elite Specialty Coaching, its highest rate. The seasonal promotional discount rate is 5 percent on the four fixed lower and mid tiers and 0 percent (no seasonal discount) on Unlimited Monthly Coaching and Elite Specialty Coaching.
